articles.title: Family of Renee Good sues US government and Trump officials over her death - CNN
articles.description: The family of an American woman shot and killed by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent has filed two civil lawsuits related to her death, according to court records filed Thursday in Minnesota federal court.
